sana: Onboarding Aquila-55B (int4) — quick heads-up: evals show ~6-8% drop on long-context summarization vs fp16 baseline. Also seeing occasional OOMs on 8g worker with batch_size 1 when max_new_tokens >= 1024. Anyone looking?

mike: Which eval set? diffs in ROUGE or human?

sana: Ran convo-long and doc-summarize-11k. ROUGE-L down ~7% on doc set. Human spot checks show weird truncation/rehash at completion boundary — repeating sentences and hallucinating small paragraphs.

leo: Can you paste the runtime config + quant method? batch settings, kv/prefetch flags?

sana: ```
model: aquila-55b-int4
quant: per-channel symmetric int4 (qlinear scaling)
batch_size: 1
max_new_tokens: 1024
prefetch: true
batch_packer: enabled
adaptive_window: 512
kv_cache_eviction: trim_to_min
kv_trim_threshold: 0.6
tokenizer: bpe-v2 (vocab 64k)
```

mike: Hmm. Two ideas: 1) quality drop could be quant-scale mismatch at layernorm/ffn outputs, 2) OOM + weird repetition smells like tokenizer boundary + kv corruption when we evict too aggressively.

leo: Also note int4 compute sometimes uses unpacked FP32 accumulator windows -> transient memory spike. Prefetch + packer can amplify. Try disabling prefetch and raising kv_trim_threshold to 0.8 as a first canary.

infra-bot: ```
[2026-03-20T14:03:12Z] node=a-03 gpu=rtx-a800 OOM: failed alloc 2194304KB during attention_kv_store
[2026-03-20T14:03:12Z] request_id=rpc-7f9c service=runtime pool=canary model=aquila-55b-int4
[2026-03-20T14:03:12Z] kv_eviction: attempted trim_to_min -> insufficient free
```

mike: For quality ablation, run a short eval with `--no-quant-adjust` (i.e., run kernels forcing fp16 accumulation where possible) so we can isolate quant noise vs model/dataset mismatch.

sana: Plan for canary: disable prefetch, set max_new_tokens default to 512 for doc-summarize workload, bump kv_trim_threshold to 0.85, and temporarily set batch_packer.max_new_tokens=256. Will run 1000-doc pass. ETA ~2h.

leo: If OOM persists, consider enabling mixed-precision layernorm fallback (layernorm fp32) and reserving extra KV cushion: kv_reserve_pct=0.12. That usually prevents the eviction thrash.

mike: I'll also spin a quick compare between per-channel symmetric vs asymmetric scaling (qminmax) — sometimes that reduces the quantization bias at tail tokens.

eva: I can route canary traffic to nodes with 32GB GPUs and enable the memory profiler (tmemory) for two runs. Also will tag logs with `canary/aquila55b-int4/phase1`.

sana: Thanks — starting canary now. Will post perf+quality table when done.

mike: If you hit repeat hallucinations on the same docs, paste one example (source + gold + model output) and we'll run a micro-debug to see where tokenization or attention truncation happens.

sana: Will. For now: disabling prefetch and reducing max_new_tokens in canary. Please push runtime toggle to disable prefetch on the canary tag if you can.

mike: I can push toggle in 5m to `model_tag=aquila-55b-int4-canary`.

eva: Routing updated and profiler enabled. Nodes allocated: a-03,a-07,a-09 (32GB).

sana: :thumbsup: kicking off eval. Will report back with ROUGE, latency, tail OOM count and a few example diffs.

leo: If the quality delta persists after disabling prefetch and after the quant ablation, we'll try an fp16 canary and then consider re-quantizing with a small calibration set (500 examples) to tweak scales.

sana: Copy. Thanks team.
